title: AR/VR Developer Roadmap
summary: Build from programming and 3D fundamentals into Unity/Unreal development, XR interaction, 3D mathematics, optimization, spatial computing and production-ready immersive applications.

facts.Timeline assumption: Four-year B.Tech/B.E. beginning in 2026 and completing around 2030. Each semester is treated as a separate portfolio-building cycle.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: build programming, 3D mathematics, game-engine, XR interaction and portfolio skills.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: specialise in AR, VR, XR interaction, graphics, Unity/Unreal, simulation or spatial computing.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: progress toward senior XR engineering, technical art, graphics, simulation or spatial-computing architecture.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: combine XR with AI, computer vision, real-time rendering, spatial computing and emerging interfaces.

Complete XR project with test plan, performance report and user documentation
2–3 polished XR projects, demo video/build, GitHub and portfolio page

blocks.text: Four-year honours variant

If your university offers a four-year honours route, use the additional depth for real-time graphics research, computer vision, spatial computing, advanced rendering, simulation or an extended XR industry project.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Keep your foundation broader than one headset or engine. Real-time rendering, computer vision, 3D mathematics, graphics programming, spatial computing and AI can transfer across future XR hardware and platforms.

blocks.label: Career progression

blocks.text: PhD routes

Keep developing skills that survive changes in XR hardware: real-time graphics, 3D mathematics, computer vision, simulation, spatial computing, AI and human-computer interaction. This allows movement between AR/VR, robotics, simulation, digital twins and other spatial-computing applications.
